data.title: Bitcoin Drops Below $59K, Wiping Out $1.5B In Crypto Bets: MSTR, BMNR, ASST Stocks Extend Losses
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC) dropped below $59,000 in afternoon trade on Friday for the first time since July, wiping out over $1.5 billion in cryptocurrency bets, as tech stocks continued to pull down broader markets.Bitcoin’s price fell nearly 6% in the last 24 hours to $58,900.
